claims.assertion: Mari presents time as a perception produced by conscious thought’s rhythm and frequency; each soul therefore experiences time uniquely.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says shared but imperfect perceptions form realms; Earth clocks synchronize people by day-night cycles, reinforcing the Matrix’s concept of constant time.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She argues time-unit duration depends on the measuring context and observer; observers in different frames may assign different durations to the same interval.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She links linear time with regret and anxiety, and says work culture can leave retirees too old to enjoy free time.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
